content.short: Hyperbloom is a DEX aggregator on HyperEVM that routes swaps across available liquidity sources.
content.description: Hyperbloom aggregates the liquidity venues on HyperEVM and routes a swap through whichever combination gives the best execution, rather than sending it to a single pool. HyperEVM's DeFi ecosystem grew quickly after the EVM layer opened, which left liquidity spread thin across venues and made aggregation genuinely useful. Hyperliquid's builder documentation lists it among the DEX aggregators for the chain.
content.meta: Hyperbloom is a HyperEVM DEX aggregator that routes swaps across the chain's liquidity venues.
